limits: Three proper rotation frames blend by normalized inverse-fourth-distance weights to fixed source anchors in the composed lumbar root. The root itself has nonunit similarity scale and an approximate BoneHub-to-Denver component.
All76 muscles and all16 diagnostic bones use the same spatial map, independent of ID/side labels. Fixed HRA anatomy stays unchanged. No per-muscle adjustment or skin-driven displacement is applied.

Root anchors are both source pelves and approximate L2-L5. Each leg anchors Femur/Tibia/Fibula. Patella and L1/L6 are excluded from the anchor surfaces and from the preceding respective rotation/lumbar fits.

Inverse-fourth weighting is experimental, not tissue mechanics or measured attachment. At a sole zero-distance anchor the exact frame limit applies. Conflicting simultaneous zero-distance frames throw; near-boundary behavior still requires checks.
Finite positive Jacobians at all vertices and triangle centroids are not proof of global injectivity, continuous surface preservation, self-intersection absence or normal anatomy.

Source internal and source-bone crossing sets are explicitly checked after Float32 triangle mapping. All current-versus-changed pairs are checked, but intersection is not clinical penetration depth or nerve/vascular course validation.
